evidence.ACL: Complete subacute tear of the ACL.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Horizontal tear of the posterior body and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.
evidence.Lateral OA: High-grade cartilage loss along the posterior lateral tibial plateau.
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Low-grade chondral fraying along the medial and lateral patellar facet.
evidence.Synovitis: Focal nodular synovial proliferation at the anterior joint line.
evidence.Contusion: Osseous contusion at the posterior lateral tibial plateau with minimal residual osseous contusion at the periphery of the medial femoral condyle and lateral femoral condyle.
